text:
Rina: starting a small docs thread. opening PR to add an "embed sharding" row to the model catalog support matrix and a concise migration note for SDK users. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/4512 :sparkles:
Tom: nice. can we scope it to two things: 1) clear per-model guidance (which models are shard-friendly) and 2) a tiny code snippet for the SDK v3 + quick TS example for our reference apps?
Mei: i can help with the table content. runtime team suggests marking Nebula3b-quant and Zephyr-mini as "shard: supported but caution" because of increased cold-start KV touch when many shards are hit. i have short notes.
Jasper: add a short migration blurb: "Old SDK used `shards` int param; v3 uses `shardConfig` object with `count` and `maxVectors` keys." lots of folks hit that in support tickets.
Rina: good call. draft wording for model-catalog row: "Shard friendliness: High | Recommended shard sizes: 64-1024 vectors | Notes: prefer fewer shards for small-batch or quantized variants" does that read ok?
Mei: fine but tighten to: "Recommended shard count: start=1, scale by throughput; shard target size: 64	60 vectors for small models, 128	512 for medium" (unicode nbsp used to avoid comma issues in table).
Tom: also add a tiny benchmark snippet: "1-shard p50=28ms, 4-shard p50=34ms, throughput 1-shard=120 req/s vs 4-shard=370 req/s (512-d vectors, batch=16)" and footnote the test environment: "Dedicated g5.4x (multi-gpu)".
Rina: here's a compact TS example to include in the PR docs area, feel free to tweak:
```ts
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
const resp = await client.embeddings.create({
  model: 'nebula3b',
  input: ['a','b','c'],
  shardConfig: { count: 2, maxVectors: 256 }
})
console.log(resp[0].vector.slice(0,8))
```
Tom: that looks good. change `maxVectors` -> `targetVectors`? our SDK PR used `targetVectors`. small consistency note.
Jasper: confirm: runtime note to add under compatibility: "When using quantized model variants, avoid >8 shards for small-batch latency-sensitive traffic; KV cache fragmentation can add ~10-15ms cold-start overhead."
Mei: i'll paste sample bench csv and a short docker command used to run the bench in the PR description to help reproducibility. PR link updated in thread: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/4512#issuecomment-22
docs-bot: lint/job started for PR #4512 1: linkcheck + snippet runner queued.
Rina: updated text, swapped `maxVectors` -> `targetVectors`, added anchor id `#shard-aware-embeddings` and a short migration note: "If migrating from SDK v2, replace `shards` with `shardConfig.count` and confirm `targetVectors` semantics."
Tom: left a tiny wording nit: replace "prefer fewer shards" with "prefer lower shard counts" for clarity.
Mei: acked, lgtm from me. i added the compatibility blurb for Nebula3b-quant.
docs-bot: snippet-tests passed (ts, python) for PR #4512. linkcheck found one broken anchor in another doc, not related.
Rina: merging once CI green. target: tomorrow morning PT. thanks y'all.
Jasper: thumbs. can you also add a one-line changelog entry under docs/changelog.md so SMEs notice?
Rina: will do post-merge. closing thread after merge. :white_check_mark:
